text: The following agencies and corporations have submitted 2017 Financial Statements and related documents to the Audit Committee for consideration: - Exhibition Place - The Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts - The North York Performing Arts Centre Corporation - St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts - Toronto Atmospheric Fund - Toronto Parking Authority - Toronto Public Library - Toronto Transit Commission - Toronto Zoo - Yonge-Dundas Square - Heritage Toronto In addition, City Council has received and forwarded the 2017 Financial Statements of the following corporations to the Audit Committee for information: - Toronto Pan Am Sports Centre Inc. - Build Toronto - Casa Loma Corporation - Invest Toronto - Lakeshore Arena - Toronto Community Housing - Toronto Port Lands

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive for information, the 2017 Financial Statements and related documents for the following agencies and corporations: - Exhibition Place - The Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts - The North York Performing Arts Centre Corporation - St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts - Toronto Atmospheric Fund - Toronto Parking Authority - Toronto Public Library - Toronto Transit Commission - Toronto Zoo - Yonge-Dundas Square - Heritage Toronto.
